population: All final-partition hours from the first fixed benchmark; no outcome-based exclusions.
models: Refit only the original fixed logistic configuration and its July sigmoid calibration. Compare with the original weekly count ranking. No new model or tuning.
dimensions: training-derived low versus other recent demand: mean of 24 completed hours <= training-input 25th percentile, higher method
selection: The original logistic top-10% final-partition budget is applied once globally; subgroup captures are intersections with that selection, not separate budgets.
display_gate: Within-group AP and Brier require >=30 hours, >=5 positives and >=5 negatives. This is a reporting guard, not statistical adequacy.
claim_boundary: Final outcomes were already examined. All subgroup differences are descriptive exploratory diagnostics, not fresh validation, model selection or significance tests.
